name: The Best Michelada

ingredients.name: lime juice, half a juiced lime reserved for the rim

instructions.primary_message: Pour Tajín (or other chile-salt mixture) or salt into a small, shallow dish in an even layer. Rub a pint or pilsner glass's rim with the cut side of the reserved juiced lime half, then dip glass into the dish to create a salt rim.

Set glass right side up and fill with lime juice, hot sauce, and Worcestershire sauce. Add a pinch or two of salt, fill glass with ice, and top with beer. Stir gently if you want to mix it up a bit. Serve with remaining beer, topping up as you drink.

description: Add as much (or as little) lime and hot sauce to this light, savory beer drink as you want.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Tajín or other chile-salt blend (optional; see note)

Optional substitutions: Kosher salt → sea salt

Notes: You can either do a classic salt rim for this drink or rim the drink with a chile-salt mix, using a brand like Tajín.
If you want a less tart version of the drink, experiment with using less lime juice—1 or 43 g can work, too. You can also make a less spicy version by reducing the hot sauce from two teaspoons to one.
author: Daniel Gritzer
